This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.710/2023 registered at Police Station-Chicholi District-Betul (MP) for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is major aged about 20 years.
Applicant and prosecutrix were in love affair.

Later on, their relationship turned sore,
therefore, false FIR was lodged as applicant was not marrying prosecutrix.
On these grounds, he prayed that applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State as well as counsel appearing for Objector opposed the application filed by applicant.
It is submitted by them that prosecutrix has given consent for physical relationship believing on false promise made by applicant.
Later on, applicant refused to marry her, therefore, offence is made out.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. It is to be decided at the time of trial, as to whether there was any false promise or not.
As per charge-sheet, prosecutrix is major aged about 20 years.
There is delay in lodging of FIR and it is also the case of prosecution that both the parties were known to each other and were on family terms.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

Applicant and prosecutrix were in love affair.
Later on, their relationship turned sore,
therefore, false FIR was lodged as applicant was not marrying prosecutrix.
On these grounds, he prayed that applicant may be enlarged on bail.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is major aged about 20 years.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Later on, applicant refused to marry her, therefore, offence is made out.
5. It is to be decided at the time of trial, as to whether there was any false promise or not.
As per charge-sheet, prosecutrix is major aged about 20 years.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
7. The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. as under:-
(a) that such person shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed under this Chapter;
(b) that such person shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected and;
(c) that such person shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
